pages.title: A Gap-Walking Umbrella
pages.text: The Border Umbrella offers several ways to bend distance. Use its item wheel to choose a mode, a saved position, and—where applicable—a travel distance. Hold the wheel key while carrying the umbrella to change these settings.

$(bold)Record$()$(br)Right-click a block to save its position in the selected slot.$(br)$(bold)Waypoint$()$(br)Right-click to teleport yourself to the selected position.$(br2)You can rename, delete, and reorder saved positions from the umbrella's management screen.

$(bold)Travel$()$(br)Hold use to charge, then dash through the Border by the selected distance. The default distance is 1000 blocks and can be changed with the item wheel.$(br2)Travel is initially sealed. Combine the umbrella with a chorus fruit in an anvil to unlock it.

$(bold)Capture$()$(br)Use the umbrella on a living creature other than a player to send it to your selected position. This can be useful for moving villagers, animals, or youkai.$(br2)Capture is initially sealed. Combine the umbrella with an echo shard in an anvil to unlock it.
